verdict.rationale: Treasury exposes money-movement primitives (OutboundPayments, ReceivedDebits, Transactions as ledger objects, and webhooks like v2.money_management.transaction.created) and fraud-guide docs mention platforms building controls for 'received credits, returns, negative balances,' suggesting some unhappy-path handling exists. However, there is no evidence of ACH-specific mechanics such as same-day ACH windows, NOC (Notification of Change) objects, or reversal objects being modeled explicitly and documented with dedicated webhooks. missing for 10: explicit ACH same-day window controls, NOC objects/webhooks, dedicated reversal object documentation, first-party ACH-specific API reference.
